title: Prospective Identifiable Return in Associative Memory: A Completed Prospective Computational Test of Identity, Correction, Discrimination, and Reliability
source_native_claims: Manuscript type (paper, Publication record): completed Tier-2 prospective computational evaluation; final publication edition v1.0; UMCP evaluative locus; contract PIR-COMP-2026-09-14-v1.0 (SHA-256 9d156e760fbe...), model freeze MODEL_FREEZE.json (SHA-256 975430177b9d...), run PIR-COMP-R1.

Lineage (paper §1, Fig. 1): immediate predecessor Paulus, Identifiable Return in Memristive Associative Memory v1.2 (10.5281/zenodo.22695434); external anchor He et al., Nature Communications 17, 3096 (2026), 10.1038/s41467-026-69958-0; SR-OBJ-000023 retained as a separate retrospective object; repository snapshot 7ff9869eae068c82c7e539d296e312591d1a5c0d.

Frozen object (paper §4, §12): ten 64-coordinate Figure-3 targets; synchronous map x_{t+1} = sign(x_t W), W = g1 - g0 (SRC-FIG3-REALWEIGHT-SYNC-SIGN-v1); independent bit-flip cues p in {0.05, 0.10, 0.20}, p = 0.50 negative control; T = 10; exact terminal target equality; development/confirmation separation with disjoint PCG64 namespaces; four L2 logistic models frozen before confirmation.

Results (paper §14, results/RESULT_PROFILE.json): 5,711/6,000 recovery-eligible confirmation trajectories reached exact intended-target equality (95.1833%); one-step 2,399/6,000; paired recurrence gain 0.5520, stratified bootstrap 95% CI [0.541667, 0.562504]; 3,312 one-step-fail/ten-step-succeed trials and zero reverse; two identity-rescue trajectories; joint-model confirmation log loss 0.134226 vs error-only 0.175544, identity-only 0.164289, correction-only 0.160711, all three Bonferroni lower bounds positive; reliability 9/10 targets pass at p = 0.05, MU-01 fails with 159/200 (0.7950, lower bound 0.712291); p = 0.50 negative control 71/2,000 (3.55%), leakage audit not triggered.

Stance (paper §14.6, §19; FINAL_STANCE.md): procedural stance CONFORMANT; identity, recurrence-specific correction, and prospective discrimination earn local computational credit; reliability is partial (9/10), the all-target reliability claim is not supported; MU-01 is retained as a negative target-level result and not repaired post hoc.

Boundary (paper Publication passport, §2.3, §17.5, §18): the study is computational; the hardware-prospective object remains NON_EVALUABLE under present public evidence and computational success does not become a new physical memristor validation; canonical tau_R, integrity, regime, return credit, and weld are not activated; no universal validation of GCD or Structura Reditus is claimed; three open burdens remain (MU-01 diagnostic, hardware-linked replication, external replication).
